# Extra mods for the "compat" test server, the same kind of mods GOML runs next to on real servers.
# One Modrinth slug per line, "slug | Name" searches Modrinth by name when the slug doesn't exist.
# Mods without a Fabric build for this Minecraft version are listed as skipped in the job summary, not failed.
# Their required dependencies are added automatically.

# Performance (they replace vanilla code GOML hooks into: explosions, fluids, pistons, entity ticking)
lithium | Lithium
servercore | ServerCore
ferrite-core | FerriteCore
krypton | Krypton
scalablelux | ScalableLux
tt20 | TT20

# Gameplay that changes how players and machines interact with blocks and entities
planting-dispensers | Planting Dispensers
mineable-spawners | Mineable Spawners
keep-my-soil-tilled | Keep My Soil Tilled
snowballs-freeze-mobs | Snowballs Freeze Mobs
invisible-frames | Invisible Frames
grabby-mobs | Grabby Mobs
axes-are-weapons | Axes Are Weapons
